steps: Put Presence of Gond on Midnight Guard.
Tap the Guard to make a 1/1 Elf.
The Elf entering untaps the Guard. Go again, as long as you like.
swap: No red? Cathars' Crusade finishes it in white. Stop at a few hundred counters and swing with whatever isn't summoning sick.
question: Two cards nobody drafts, and they end the game. Why isn't this everywhere?
